predictions.rationale: Provides a UI panel for inspecting the Argo EventPump, letting developers trace and view internal events; strongly aligned with runtime debug/trace logging.
Initialises and registers the whole developer/debug subsystem (menus, actions, panels) that surface debug log and trace facilities.
Creates the menu/toolbar actions used to enable or open logging-related developer panels; central entry point for activating logging features.
UI panel that displays the undo/redo event log, giving detailed trace information useful for debugging application behaviour.
Wraps the core UndoManager while recording operations for the UndoLogPanel; directly responsible for producing undo trace messages.
Displays current input modes and their transitions, aiding developers in tracing GUI state changes; part of the debug logging toolkit.
Builds tree nodes representing messages/events shown in inspector panels; indirectly supports structured display of logged information.
Generates call-stack related nodes for developer views, letting users trace which code paths produced particular log messages.
Central dispatcher for application events; many debug panels hook into it to monitor and log internal events.
Global AWT exception handler that captures and outputs stack traces, contributing to the overall debug logging capability.
